summary: Compare candidate pilot-only screens by honest nested CV of RF, KNN and their soft vote on pilot data.
reasoning: Diagnosis so far (pilot only, out/diag1.txt): F-statistic separates 4 very strong features (F 25-33), a mid tier around F 10-13 (x445, x159, x339, x129, x360, x414, x106), and a spurious tail below F 7 that keeps only 0.25-0.45 of bootstrap resamples. A raw F top-K screen (likely what the refuted compact-knn/compact-forest routes used) pulls in many probes; that plausibly is why KNN and RF on screened features missed the floor. Plan: check correlation structure, build stability-based screens (>=0.5, >=0.3 of bootstrap resamples) versus raw F top-K, and run one honest nested-CV comparison (screen refit inside each outer fold, hyperparameters tuned inside inner folds) of RF, KNN and their soft vote on each candidate screen. All on data/pilot.csv. The winner decides the locked procedure for the single held-out scoring run; no heldout.csv read yet and no route metrics written.
